information:
## Welcome to the gateway KLIA2 Cube Open 2025!
[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/gatewayKLIA2CubeOpen2025)
​
## 📌 All participants will receive perks such as a T-shirt, an exclusive gift, a certificate of participation, a name tag, and a lanyard 📌

**If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Updates & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/gatewayKLIA2CubeOpen2025#57102-updates-announcements) and the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/gatewayKLIA2CubeOpen2025#57104-new-competitors) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.**
​
Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.
​
***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
